title: WorldProtocol
description: Every type on the world socket. Generated from apps/world/src/socket/protocol.ts; do not edit by hand. This root is a catalogue and is never sent: a frame is a ClientMessage or a ServerMessage, and a close carries a CloseCode and a CloseReason. How to use them — moving, correcting, closing — is in docs/world-protocol.md.

Direction.description: One tile in screen terms: up is y - 1, right is x + 1.

x.description: Tile column, from 0 at the left edge.

y.description: Tile row, from 0 at the top edge.

Player.description: Somebody on the map, as the server has them. Positions are tiles, never pixels.

Status.description: Whether somebody can be approached. available: the default. busy: they would rather not be. away: not at the keyboard — chosen, or set for them by the server once they have done nothing for `awayAfterSeconds`, and cleared when they do something again. Lasts as long as their connection.

x.description: Tile column, from 0 at the left edge.

y.description: Tile row, from 0 at the top edge.

displayName.description: The name to show beside them. Null when they have set none.

spriteKey.description: Which character to draw them as. Null when they have picked none; draw the default then, and for a key you have no sprite for.

spaceKey.description: The space they are standing in: a drawn space's key, or `_default` for the corridors and grounds.

Avatar.description: Somebody on the map and what to draw for them. A later change to their sprite or name arrives as an `appearance` message, to their status as a `statusChanged`, and to their space as a `spaceChanged`.

url.description: The media server to connect to.

token.description: Lets you join this room only, for about ten minutes.

hearing.description: room: subscribe to everybody in it. proximity: subscribe only to the people the latest `nearby` names.

audibleRadius.description: In tiles, for proximity: fade a voice to nothing across this distance.

subscribeRadius.description: In tiles, for proximity: how far `nearby` reaches.

Call.description: The audio call for the space you are standing in. A participant’s identity starts with their user id and a colon.

MoveOutcome.description: moved: one tile in the direction asked. blocked: the tile is not walkable; they turn to face it without moving. refused: the tile is floor, but in a space they may not enter (designated and not on its list, or locked); they turn to face it without moving. too_fast: over walking speed; nothing happens, not even the turn.

direction.description: Which way, never where to: the server works out the tile.

seq.description: The client's own counter, echoed on the `moveResult` so it can match the answer to the step it already drew.

MoveMessage.description: One step. Always answered with a `moveResult`.

SetStatusMessage.description: Choose your status. Answered, if it changes what your cohort sees, by the `statusChanged` everybody in it gets, you included. Counts as activity.

ActiveMessage.description: The person did something the server cannot see — a key, a click, a word in a call. Keeps them from going away while idle, and brings them back if they had. A `move` or `setStatus` counts already; a `ping` does not. No answer.

SetLockMessage.description: Lock or unlock the space you are standing in, if `lockableSpaces` names it. Anybody inside may, guests included. Answered, if it changes anything, by the `lockChanged` everybody in your cohort gets, you included; in a space that cannot be locked, by a NOT_ALLOWED error. Counts as activity.

SayMessage.description: A line of chat to whoever can hear you: everybody in a whole-room space, or the people within its subscribe radius in a proximity space, as for its call. Up to 500 characters, trimmed. Answered by the `said` you and they get; five lines at once, then one a second, after which a NOT_ALLOWED error. Never stored. Counts as activity.

ClientMessage.description: Every frame a client may send.

stepMs.description: Walking speed: one tile per this many milliseconds. Animate a step over this long, and send no faster, or moves come back `too_fast`.

tickMs.description: How often `moved` arrives while anybody is moving.

awayAfterSeconds.description: How long you may do nothing before the server shows you away. Send `active` well within it while the person is there. 0 when this deployment never does.

displayName.description: The name to show beside them. Null when they have set none.

spriteKey.description: Which character to draw them as. Null when they have picked none; draw the default then, and for a key you have no sprite for.

WelcomeMessage.description: First frame on a socket that was let in.

id.description: Which published map this is. With `version`, what to load: the server enforces exactly that one.

version.description: The published version the server loaded. Load this version, not the current one: a map published since would have walls the server does not.

lockableSpaces.description: The spaces whoever stands inside may lock. No other space can be, nor the corridors. The same in every cohort.

lockedSpaces.description: The spaces locked in your cohort right now.

SnapshotMessage.description: Sent once, right after `welcome`: the map, and everybody in your cohort on it, you included. Nobody from another cohort is ever in it.

JoinedMessage.description: Somebody arrived in your cohort. Not sent when a socket is replaced within the same cohort, because the avatar never left.

displayName.description: The name to show beside them. Null when they have set none.

spriteKey.description: Which character to draw them as. Null when they have picked none; draw the default then, and for a key you have no sprite for.

AppearanceMessage.description: Somebody in your cohort changed their sprite or display name, you included: draw them with these from now on. Sent as soon as they save the change.

LeftMessage.description: Somebody's socket in your cohort closed. Entering another cohort is not leaving this one.

StatusChangedMessage.description: Somebody in your cohort's status changed: chosen, or set to away while idle and back again. Sent to everybody in the cohort, you included when it is yours.

spaceKey.description: The space they are standing in: a drawn space's key, or `_default` for the corridors and grounds.

SpaceChangedMessage.description: Somebody in your cohort stepped into another space. Sent to everybody in the cohort, you included when it is you, the moment the step is taken: it can arrive before the `moved` that shows the step.

CallMessage.description: Sent on arrival and each time you step into another space: leave the call you are in and join this one. Null where there is no call to join.

NearbyMessage.description: In a proximity space, who is close enough to hear, each time that changes: subscribe to their audio and drop everybody else’s. Can arrive before the `call` it applies to.

userId.description: Who locked or unlocked it. Null when the lock ended on its own: the last person inside left, or the space can no longer be locked.

LockChangedMessage.description: A space in your cohort was locked or unlocked. While it is locked, a step into it is refused, admins excepted. Sent to everybody in the cohort, you included.

LockableSpacesMessage.description: Which spaces can be locked changed, because an admin changed a space: replaces the list from `snapshot`.

spaceKey.description: The space they said it in, so a meeting’s chat can be kept apart.

at.description: When world relayed it, as an ISO timestamp.

SaidMessage.description: A line of chat from somebody who could be heard where you stand when they said it, or your own. World keeps none of it: a line reaches whoever is in earshot at that moment and nobody later.

ReplacedMessage.description: This account opened this cohort's campus somewhere else — another device or tab — and that connection has taken its place. Being in another cohort never causes this. The socket closes immediately afterwards with 4000 `entered_elsewhere`. Do NOT reconnect: the two connections would replace each other for as long as both stayed open. Show that they are in this campus elsewhere, and reconnect only when they ask to come back here.

MovedMessage.description: Everybody in your cohort who moved or turned since the last tick, once each, as they stand now: two steps inside one tick arrive as the second, so an entry can be more than one tile from where they were. Sent once per tick, and not at all when nobody moved. You are never in your own `moved` frame — your `moveResult` already says where you ended up.

MoveResultMessage.description: The answer to one admitted `move`. `player` is where the server has them; on anything but `moved`, the client snaps back to it.

ErrorMessage.description: UNAUTHORIZED comes just before the socket closes with 1008, `message` being the reason. BAD_MESSAGE leaves the socket open. NOT_ALLOWED answers a message the server understood but will not act on, and leaves the socket open.

ServerMessage.description: Every frame the server may send.

anyOf.description: Close 1008. No session was sent. Send them to sign in.
Close 1008. The session sent is not usable: expired, or signed before a change to what a token carries. Try a refresh; if that fails, send them to sign in.
Close 1008. The access token an open socket opened with ran out, and it follows no sign-in. Try a refresh; if that fails, send them to sign in.
Close 1008. Signed out, or the sign-in stopped being refreshed. Try a refresh; if that fails, send them to sign in.
Close 1008. The account's sessions were ended on purpose. Send them to sign in; a refresh will not work.
Close 1008. Still in onboarding. Send them to onboarding.
Close 1008. The account is suspended. Sign them out; do not reconnect.
Close 1008. The account no longer exists. Sign them out; do not reconnect.
Close 1008. This page's origin is not on world's list. Configuration; do not retry.
Close 1008. The upgrade named no cohortId. Client bug; do not retry without one.
Close 1008. No live membership in the cohort named; admins excepted. Back to the cohort picker; do not retry.
Close 1008. Sustained sending over the message budget. Client bug; reconnect with backoff.
Close 4000. This account opened this cohort's campus somewhere else. Do not reconnect: show that they are in this campus elsewhere, and reconnect only when they ask.
Close 1001. A deploy or restart. Reconnect.
Close 1011. The server could not check the session. Reconnect with backoff.

CloseReason.description: The reason world gives when it closes the socket, read from the close event. Each says which code comes with it and what to do. A 1008 reason this list does not have should be treated as "stop": never retry a refusal you do not understand.

anyOf.description: A refusal, or access ending on an open socket. What to do depends on the reason: see CloseReason.
The server could not check the session. Reconnect with backoff.
The account opened this cohort elsewhere. Do not reconnect.

CloseCode.description: The close codes world sends. Two more reach a client without world sending them: 1006, from the browser, when the connection is lost, a heartbeat is missed or the client reads too slowly (reconnect with backoff); and 1009, from the socket library, for a frame over the size limit (client bug; reconnect).
